title: Eurosystem invites industry consortia to test tokenized deposits and securities
why_it_matters: The invitation gives banks, infrastructure operators and technology providers a concrete route into shaping European tokenized-market design, including how deposit payments, securities and shared governance could work across institutions.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Eurosystem invites industry consortia to test tokenized deposits and securities

In a November 20 invitation, the Eurosystem opened applications for collective industry initiatives to work on Appia's three design streams, with a December 11 deadline for the first experiments.
